claims.claim: SpaceX terminals initially cost about $3,000 each to manufacture and reached about $1,300 by early 2021.
claims.episode_span: Manufacturing cost for a Starlink terminal fell from three thousand dollars to below six hundred.
claims.source_title: SpaceX no longer taking losses to produce Starlink satellite antennas
claims.supporting_quote: When SpaceX first began selling its Starlink service, company leadership said the terminals cost about $3,000 each to manufacture. The company improved that to about $1,300 per terminal by early 2021.

claims.claim: STMicroelectronics has shipped more than 5 billion radio-frequency antenna chips to SpaceX since around 2015.
claims.episode_span: More than five billion of these chips have shipped since the collaboration began around 2015.
claims.source_title: Starlink and Satellite Semiconductor Supply Chain
claims.supporting_quote: STMicroelectronics has shipped more than 5 billion radio-frequency antenna chips to SpaceX since the work began around 2015

claims.claim: SpaceX announced a $280 million expansion of its Bastrop, Texas facility in March 2025.
claims.episode_span: The same consolidation pattern could next appear in other high-volume sensor arrays once a single buyer commits to the required chip volumes.
claims.source_title: Starlink and Satellite Semiconductor Supply Chain
claims.supporting_quote: In March 2025 SpaceX announced a $280 million expansion, backed by a $17.3 million grant from the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund

claims.claim: SpaceX produces more than 20,000 Starlink terminals per day.
claims.episode_span: Production now exceeds twenty thousand terminals per day, a volume that justified the capital investment in automated lines.
claims.source_title: STMicroelectronics supplies billions of components for Starlink
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX currently produces more than 20,000 Starlink terminals per day, shipping hardware to customers globally.
